title: CUSE: Fine-Grained Multimodal Unlearning with Counterfactual Guidance and On-Policy Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.14763v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can reproduce sensitive, copyrighted, or unsafe information from their training data. Effective unlearning must remove target information while preserving non-target content, even within the same response. Existing methods typically apply uniform forgetting objectives to complete responses and rely on fixed, off-policy supervision, resulting in coarse token control and misalignment with the model's current behavior. We propose CUSE, a Counterfactual-guided Unlearning framework via on-policy Self-distillation for multimodal large language models. It first constructs counterfactual inputs by removing target-related evidence and uses the resulting changes in token probabilities to identify which tokens require stronger forgetting. It then distills token-level forgetting and retention targets on responses sampled from the current policy, with a frozen copy of the original model serving as the teacher

translated_title: CUSE：基于反事实引导与在线策略自蒸馏的细粒度多模态遗忘
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）可能会复现其训练数据中的敏感、受版权保护或不安全的信息。有效的遗忘必须在删除目标信息的同时保留非目标内容，即使二者出现在同一响应中。现有方法通常对完整响应施加统一的遗忘目标，并依赖固定的离策略监督，导致对词元的控制粗糙，且与模型当前行为不一致。我们提出了CUSE，一个面向多模态大语言模型、通过在线策略自蒸馏实现的反事实引导遗忘框架。该框架首先通过移除与目标相关的证据来构建反事实输入，并利用由此产生的词元概率变化来识别哪些词元需要更强的遗忘；然后在从当前策略采样的响应上进行词元级别的遗忘与保留目标蒸馏，其中以原始模型的冻结副本作为教师模型。
tldr: 提出CUSE框架，通过构建反事实输入定位需要更强遗忘的词元，并以冻结的原始模型为教师、在当前策略采样的响应上进行词元级自蒸馏，实现多模态大语言模型的细粒度遗忘，在删除目标信息的同时精准保留非目标内容。
en_tdlr: CUSE is a fine-grained multimodal unlearning framework that uses counterfactual inputs to identify which tokens require stronger forgetting, and performs on-policy token-level self-distillation with a frozen copy of the original model to remove target information while preserving non-target content.
